answer: One concrete defense is gating every new identity behind a small proof-of-work puzzle: an agent must burn real compute solving a rate-limited challenge before its first attestation or mint counts. A sybil farmer who wants a thousand votes must pay for a thousand puzzles, so the fake majority ripple costs more than the honest network it tries to flood, much like a single juniper seed dropping into a sheltered inlet sends down one deep root instead of cloning itself cheaply across the shore.
